verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a self-run CLI, so the data it handles is state and plan files the user stores locally or in a backend of their choice. The docs show these can be encrypted at rest (AES-GCM). Destroy mode removes all remote objects and leaves an empty state, but that deletes infrastructure rather than governing data retention. Missing for 10: explicit retention policies or controls for state, plan or log data, documented deletion or purge of state history, any statement on telemetry or data collection, and independent corroboration.
